cases.title: Marketplace is off for a shop that never opted in

cases.pre: Nobody has switched the marketplace on for this shop.

steps.do: Log in as owner.pesticide@myplus.com (password Demo@2025!). Open Sale in the left menu.
steps.expect: The Sale menu has no "Marketplace" entry.

steps.do: Open Settings → Configuration and find "Sell on the MaxTheService marketplace".
steps.expect: The switch is OFF. Its help text reads "List your products beside other sellers on the MaxTheService marketplace. MaxTheService approves your seller account first. Off until you switch it on."

cases.title: The owner cannot switch it on before MaxTheService entitles the shop
cases.pre: As M-0a-01: the shop is on the FREE plan and not entitled.

steps.do: Settings → Configuration → try to tick "Sell on the MaxTheService marketplace".
steps.expect: The switch is greyed out and cannot be ticked. Under it a "Not in plan" badge with a lock says why. No error page.

steps.do: Developer tools (or the API): POST /mkt/acceptAgreement {"version":"v1","displayName":"Should not exist"}, then GET /mkt/seller.
steps.expect: The POST is refused: "… not switched on …". The GET answers and shows no seller account (account: null) — the refused write created nothing.

body.message: Selling on the MaxTheService marketplace is not switched on for this business. An owner can switch it on in Settings → Configuration.

found: Case text corrected: for a shop that is not entitled the switch is greyed out with a "Not in plan" badge — it was described as "refused on save".

cases.title: The owner switches it on, reads the agreements and applies
cases.persona: admin@myplus.com (operator), then owner.audit@myplus.com (a shop that has never applied)

"Accept and apply" is greyed out.

steps.expect: "Accept and apply" becomes active.

steps.do: Click "Accept and apply".
steps.expect: The lines read "Agreements accepted (version v1)." and "MaxTheService is reviewing your seller account." The agreement box closes.

cases.title: Only MaxTheService approves a seller, and a suspension says why

steps.do: Customer: open the product (Karachi), choose Shahzad Mobile Shop, press "Buy from Shahzad Mobile Shop". Name "Ali", phone 03003839561, address "1 Clifton". Check the total.
steps.expect: Total Rs. 52,000. The payment line reads "Cash on delivery: you pay the seller when the order arrives. Nothing is charged now."

steps.do: Press "Place order".
steps.expect: "Waiting for Shahzad Mobile Shop to confirm", an order number MKT-…, and "Shahzad Mobile Shop has 4:5x to confirm. Your stock is held." The address bar shows ?order=MKT-… and NO phone number.

steps.do: As owner.business@myplus.com: Sale → Marketplace → "Incoming marketplace orders" ("Waiting for you").
steps.expect: The order is listed with the items, Ali, the phone and address, and a countdown under 5:00 running down.

steps.do: Press Accept.
steps.expect: The row turns to "Accepted" with "Invoice INV-…", "In your orders as …" and "Accepted. The sale is in your books; deliver and collect the cash."

steps.do: Customer: reopen the order page (the same address, with the phone number) and wait up to 10 seconds.
steps.expect: "Confirmed by Shahzad Mobile Shop" and "Shahzad Mobile Shop will deliver and collect Rs. 52,000 in cash."

cleanup.do: None: an accepted sale is a real sale in the seller's books (return it with the store's Sale Returns if needed).

found: DEFECT, fixed (gate): after Accept the order vanished from "Waiting for you", so the seller never saw it go through. The row now turns to Accepted in place, with the server's sentence.

cases.title: The seller rejects: the stock comes back and the customer is told
cases.persona: Two customers (two incognito windows), then owner.business@
cases.pre: Shahzad Mobile Shop has a second Live offer with exactly 2 in stock (another phone, its own product).

steps.do: Customer 1 (phone 03003839563): open that product, choose Shahzad Mobile Shop, Quantity 2, Place order.
steps.expect: "Waiting for Shahzad Mobile Shop to confirm". Both units are now held.

steps.do: Customer 2 (another window, phone 03003839564): the same product, Quantity 1, Place order.

steps.do: As owner.business@: Incoming → the order for 2 → leave the reason box EMPTY → Reject.
steps.expect: Refused under the buttons: "Give a reason. MaxTheService support will see it." The order still waits.

steps.do: Type "out of stock in store" in the reason box and press Reject.
steps.expect: The row turns to "Rejected" with the reason.

steps.do: Customer 1: reopen the order page.
steps.expect: "Cancelled" and "The seller could not fulfil this order."

steps.do: Customer 2: Place order again.
steps.expect: "Waiting for Shahzad Mobile Shop to confirm": the stock came back.

cleanup.do: As owner.business@: Incoming → Reject customer 2's order with the reason "walk cleanup".

cases.title: Nobody answers: the hold expires, and a late Accept is refused
cases.pre: As M-1d-01.

steps.do: As admin@myplus.com: Platform → Marketplace policies → "Minutes a seller has to accept an order" = 1 → Save.
steps.expect: Saved.

steps.do: Customer (phone 03003839565): order Shahzad Mobile Shop's phone. The seller does nothing.
steps.expect: "Shahzad Mobile Shop has 0:5x to confirm. Your stock is held."

steps.do: Wait about 2 minutes (the minute, a 30-second grace and one sweep). Reopen the customer's order page.
steps.expect: "Cancelled" and "The seller did not confirm in time." The stock is free again.

steps.do: As owner.business@: Incoming → choose "All".
steps.expect: The order reads "Expired", with no Accept button.

steps.do: Developer tools: replay the Accept the seller's page would have sent before the expiry (POST /mkt/acceptOrder with the old version).
steps.expect: Refused: "This order expired before it was accepted." — not "someone else changed it".

body.message: This order expired before it was accepted.

cleanup.do: As admin@: "Minutes a seller has to accept an order" = 5 → Save.

found: DEFECT, fixed (gate): a late Accept on an expired order said "someone else changed this". The outcome is now checked before the version (MarketplaceOrderFlowTest).

cases.title: A double click, or a lost answer, is still one order
cases.pre: As M-1d-01.

steps.do: Fill the checkout for Shahzad Mobile Shop (phone 03003839566) and DOUBLE-click "Place order".
steps.expect: One order number. The seller has exactly ONE order for that phone.

steps.do: Another order (phone 03003839567): the server PLACES it, but the answer is lost on the way back (developer tools: the response replaced by "504 Gateway Timeout").
steps.expect: The page does not guess: "We could not confirm your order. Press the button again; it will not be placed twice."

steps.do: Press "Place order" again.
steps.expect: The order the server had already placed is shown — the SAME one: the seller has exactly ONE order for that phone.

cleanup.do: As owner.business@: Reject both orders with the reason "walk cleanup".

body.message: Rejected. The stock is released and the shopper is told.
Rejected. The stock is released and the shopper is told.

found: DEFECT, fixed: when the answer was lost (a 504 or a timeout) the page treated it as a "no", dropped its attempt key, and a second press placed a SECOND order. The proxy now says UNKNOWN and the page keeps the key (MarketplacePublicControllerTest).

cases.title: Phase 1 is cash on delivery; a seller who takes no cash is not offered
cases.pre: As M-1d-01.

steps.do: Customer: open the checkout for any seller.
steps.expect: "Cash on delivery: you pay the seller when the order arrives. Nothing is charged now." No card or wallet choice.

steps.do: The seller switches cash on delivery OFF (store delivery setting "Accept cash on delivery", key order.payment.codEnabled), then a customer tries to order from them.
steps.expect: Refused at "Place order": "This seller does not accept cash on delivery yet. Please choose another offer." Nothing is held.
steps.flow: SCREEN NOT AVAILABLE: the setting lives in marketplace-service and has no screen in the business dashboard yet (Configuration lists business-service and auth settings only). Written from MarketplaceCheckoutService.checkout (line 137).
steps.proof: Unit test MarketplaceOrderFlowTest.codOffRefused (added 2026-10-03: this refusal had no test before).

found: GAP, open: a seller cannot switch cash on delivery off from any screen (the setting lives in marketplace-service; Configuration shows business and auth settings only). The refusal had no test: MarketplaceOrderFlowTest.codOffRefused added.

cases.title: Phones need their IMEI; nothing is let go before it is given
cases.pre: Shahzad Mobile Shop has a Live phone offer whose product is set to "requires serial number" (Products → edit → "Track serial numbers"), and RECEIVED two of those phones with their IMEIs on a purchase (Purchase → New purchase, IMEIs typed in). A customer has ordered 2.

steps.do: As owner.business@: Incoming → the order for 2 → press Accept without typing any IMEI.
steps.expect: Refused under the buttons: "Enter the serial number (IMEI) of each unit you are sending: 2 for …". The order still waits; the stock stays held.

steps.do: Type ONE IMEI (350361443839561) and press Accept.
steps.expect: The same refusal: two units need two IMEIs.

steps.do: Type the second IMEI (350361443839562) and press Accept.
steps.expect: Accepted: "Invoice INV-…"; the invoice records those two IMEIs as sold. (An IMEI the shop never received is refused: "The sale could not be recorded: Serial … is not in stock." — and the order keeps waiting, stock held.)

cleanup.do: None: the sale is real. Undo it through the store's Sale Returns if needed.

found: Case corrected: an IMEI must have been RECEIVED on a purchase to be sold; an unknown one is refused ("Serial … is not in stock") and the order keeps waiting.
